name: Fleak
title: fleak.ai
shortDescription: Fleak is an AI-powered platform designed to streamline the creation and management of serverless APIs and AI workflows. It serves enterprises looking to reduce engineering time and maintain control over their systems. An example use case is transforming data inputs into a desired schema automatically, which is especially beneficial for large organizations dealing with diverse data systems.
pros: Automatically adapts to changes in data
cons: Dependent on continuous updates for new features
